name: Serotonin synthesis and monoamine catabolism
rationale: Members cover serotonin/melatonin synthesis and secretion together with MAO- and COMT-mediated breakdown of biogenic amines, whereas confusables centre on monoamine uptake/transport or catecholamine synthesis.

qualifier: contractile ring cytokinesis and ESCRT-III nuclear envelope sealing
name: Contractile ring cytokinesis and ESCRT nuclear envelope sealing
rationale: All members concern the closing stages of mitosis: actomyosin/septin ring, furrowing and abscission plus ESCRT-III-driven nuclear envelope reassembly, unlike confusables focused on nuclear envelope breakdown or spindle midzone assembly.

name: Fc-gamma receptor signaling, ADCC and hypersensitivity
rationale: Members are Fc-gamma receptor activating/inhibitory signaling, antibody-dependent cytotoxicity and antibody-driven hypersensitivity/acute inflammation, distinct from the Fc-epsilon mast cell and Fc-gamma phagocytosis confusables.

name: Regulation of cardiomyocyte proliferation and regeneration
rationale: All members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, growth, differentiation or regeneration, whereas confusables cover heart morphogenesis or hypertrophic adaptation.

name: Regulation of leukocyte-endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: Members regulate leukocyte (neutrophil, T cell) adhesion to vascular endothelium and diapedesis, unlike confusables centred on integrin/shear-stress signaling or monocyte activation.

name: Regulation of amyloid precursor protein turnover
rationale: Members regulate APP biosynthesis and catabolism plus the (obsolete) amide metabolic terms that house the same regulators, whereas confusables concern amyloid-beta clearance, fibrils and glial activation.

core: Organogenesis of pharyngeal and craniofacial derivatives
qualifier: thymus, thyroid, parathyroid, palate and spleen
name: Pharyngeal gland, palate and spleen organogenesis
rationale: Members are development of pharyngeal-pouch glands (thymus, thyroid, parathyroid), the palate and spleen, distinct from neural, limb and outflow-tract development confusables.

qualifier: stress-induced translational control and IRE1/PERK regulation
name: ER unfolded protein response and stress translational control
rationale: Members cover the UPR, regulation of its IRE1/PERK branches and ER-stress apoptosis plus translational initiation control under stress, unlike confusables on ATF6/chaperone transcription or HRI/GCN2 integrated stress signaling.

name: ER quality control and retrotranslocation for degradation
rationale: Members concern ER retention/exit control, mannose trimming in the ERQC and retrograde ER-to-cytosol transport for ERAD, unlike confusables on ER targeting/insertion, COPII export or ERAD regulation without retrotranslocation.

qualifier: olfactory system development and chemosensory behavior
name: Olfactory perception, development and chemosensory behaviors
rationale: Members are smell perception, olfactory receptors, odorant/pheromone responses, nose and olfactory nerve development and chemically driven behaviors, whereas confusables centre on taste perception or cranial gland development.

name: Cyclooxygenase prostaglandin synthesis and prostanoid signaling
rationale: Members cover PLA2 arachidonate release, COX-mediated prostaglandin/thromboxane synthesis, its regulation and prostanoid receptor responses, unlike leukotriene/lipoxin or P450 epoxygenase confusables.

name: Ketone body metabolism and carnitine transport
rationale: Members are ketone body synthesis/utilization and carnitine transport/shuttle (including carnitine deficiency), distinct from beta-oxidation step confusables.

name: M-CSF signaling and macrophage proliferation
rationale: All three members concern macrophage colony-stimulating factor signaling and macrophage proliferation, unlike microglial or IL-6-family cytokine confusables.

name: SLIT-ROBO receptor signaling via Rho GTPase effectors
rationale: Members describe intracellular ROBO signaling (RHOA, CDC42/RAC1 inactivation, ABL, AKAP5), whereas confusables cover axon guidance outcomes, SLIT/ROBO expression or netrin/ephrin cues.

name: RIG-I-like receptor dsRNA sensing and regulation
rationale: Members are RIG-I/MDA5 signaling, its positive and negative regulation and dsRNA responses, unlike confusables centred on IRF3/IFN induction, DNA sensing or viral modulation.

qualifier: proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation
name: Proteasome assembly and HIV Nef/Vpu receptor degradation
rationale: Members combine proteasome assembly and ubiquitin-proteasome antigen processing with HIV Nef/Vpu-driven degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I, unlike confusables on MHC peptide loading or PD-L1 degradation.

qualifier: branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and its deficiencies
name: Lipoylated 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases and branched-chain ketoaciduria
rationale: Members are PDH, OGDH, OADH, BCKDH and glycine cleavage reactions that share lipoylated E2/DLD subunits, with BCKDH-related maple syrup urine disease distinguishing it from TCA, PDH-regulation and leucine-catabolism confusables.

qualifier: stem cell maintenance and peri-implantation trophoblast
name: Peri-implantation lineage specification and stem cell maintenance
rationale: Members cover ICM/trophectoderm and germ cell specification, stem cell maintenance, trophoblast giant cells and decidualization, unlike placental labyrinth or germ-cell maturation confusables.

qualifier: ionizing radiation response and p53 regulation
name: Ionizing radiation-induced G2 checkpoint and p53 regulation
rationale: Members cover radiation responses, G2 DNA damage checkpoint signaling, CDK inhibition, Cdc25A/p53 regulation, senescence and checkpoint recovery, unlike confusables on p14ARF/p53 apoptosis, AKT or unperturbed G2/M progression.

name: TGF-beta/SMAD transcription and RUNX3 target regulation
rationale: Members cover SMAD2/3:SMAD4 transcription and its downregulation alongside RUNX3-controlled targets (BIM, p21, ARF, YAP1), unlike confusables on BMP/activin or cancer receptor mutants.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
name: Antiviral nucleic acid sensing and type I/III interferon response
rationale: Members span RIG-I-like, endosomal TLR and cytosolic DNA sensing, IRF/NF-kB activation and type I/III interferon responses, a broad core of which the confusables cover only narrow cGAS-STING, PKR or viral-modulation slices.

qualifier: caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes with IL-18
name: Caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasome pyroptosis and IL-18
rationale: Members are non-canonical caspase-4/5, AIM2 and NLRC4 inflammasomes, GBP/bacterial detection, pyroptosis and IL-18 signaling, unlike NLRP3/NLRP1 IL-1 confusables or apoptosis/necroptosis ones.

qualifier: endosomal and ER membranes plus inositol phosphate turnover
name: Endosomal and ER phosphoinositide and inositol phosphate turnover
rationale: Members are PIP synthesis at ER and early/late endosome membranes, phosphatidylinositol dephosphorylation and inositol phosphate breakdown, unlike Golgi/plasma membrane PIP or lipid-transfer confusables.

name: Presynaptic vesicle cycle with clathrin-mediated endocytosis
rationale: Members regulate presynaptic vesicle clustering, endocytosis and recycling with clathrin coat dynamics, unlike confusables on release-cycle docking/fusion or postsynaptic receptor trafficking.

name: Tryptophan catabolism via kynurenine
rationale: All members describe tryptophan breakdown to and through kynurenine, unlike confusables on threonine, tyrosine or histidine catabolism.
